name: IDS Validator
description: Read-only check of an IFC file against a buildingSMART IDS file (needs the optional ids extra: ifctester). Per-specification pass/fail and failing GlobalIds; optional HTML or JSON report in the workspace.
author: AEC Model Bridge

ifc_path.description: Path of the .ifc file, inside the workspace.

ids_path.description: Path of the .ids file, inside the workspace.

max_failed.description: Failing entities listed per specification (1 to 500); the counts are always complete.

html_filename.description: Optional .html report file name inside the workspace.

json_filename.description: Optional .json file name inside the workspace for the capped result.
